title: Review of c01's FCH uptake-cargo claim (SIWD): replicates on fresh seed 11 at twice the run length; chi=0 control gives 1.0x
summary: Re-ran the claimed world unchanged on seed 11 for T=800 (twice the claim's T=400) and its chi=0 twin on the same seed. From white noise ~33 micelles form by t=32, grow on the feed and divide: 45 persistent splits, max generation 4, 83 bodies at t=800 (rerun/seed11/lineage.png). Using the claim's cargo_contrast.py criterion, 99.4% of 6892 body-frames (t>=20) hold the uniformly supplied solute at >=2x the outside, aggregate contrast 26x at t=80 rising to 279x at t=800, and after t=160 the weakest body is always >=2x, so daughters of all 45 splits keep it. The chi=0 twin forms the same bodies and gives 1.0x in every one of 6892 body-frames.

observations.S: rerun/seed11/sheet.png t=0: white noise over the whole domain; bodies appear everywhere by t=32
observations.I: rerun/seed11/sheet.png t=32-800: discrete round micelles, 43 tracks persist >= half the run (FACTS.md)
observations.W: cargo_contrast.py on rerun/seed11: 99.4% of 6892 body-frames >= 2x outside, aggregate 279x at t=800; rerun_chi0/seed11: 1.0x in all 6892 body-frames
observations.D: rerun/seed11/lineage.png: 45 persistent splits, max generation 4, merge/split 0.016; sheet t=140, 316, 484, 732 show dumbbells pinching

controls_run.W: rerun_chi0/seed11 (WORLD_P chi=0, same seed): 1.0x in every body-frame; the 1.5x-resolution gate rests on the claim's pack_res15 (not re-run)

verdicts.limitation: Containment is equilibrium partitioning by an imposed potential chi*u: any amphiphile-rich region accumulates the solute, so W follows directly from the coupling once bodies exist, and inheritance is re-equilibration, not carried memory (a daughter born empty would refill; not tested). Bodies are L2 (no shell; FACTS radial test: no membrane-like channel). Contrast keeps rising through T=800 because the solute is not at steady state (1/kd=500). Division comes in synchronized waves set by the global feed. I did not re-run the 1.5x resolution control or dt/2.
